panels.title: Execution
panels.description:
The picked Run (Newest Live Run by default), at its newest second, whatever the Range. Green well, amber needs a look, red trading at risk, grey nothing to judge; a time plain.

- **Mode**: LIVE (real orders on Bitget) or PAPER (the program trades against its own copy of the books; nothing is sent): a Run is one mode, and every panel shows the picked Run only, so paper and live are never merged.
- **Run**: up for how long; starting (no sample yet); stale (no sample for more than 10 s and no stop recorded); lost (none for a minute: crashed or killed); stopped (in order).
- **Start / End**: when the Run started; for a stopped one, when it stopped; UTC+8.
- **Phase**: the US market phase, worded and coloured as on Combo Spread: Pre‑Mkt, Regular, After‑Hrs, Overnight, Closed (weekend or holiday); the program enters outside Regular only.
- **Books**: ok, or a leg whose book conflicts (snapshot and ticks disagree) or is unusable (too old or thin): no entry goes out on it.
- **Orders**: the Run's orders not final: n working, n unknown (being queried), or n left open by a stopped Run.
- **Entry**: the program's answer this second: ready (no signal yet) or order sent; the strategy's ordinary answers in grey (regular hours, spacing, quota used up, ...); held (waits on a book, F, the venue or a stop); stop (a person is needed).

     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND s.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)

     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample i WHERE i.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND i.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND i.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)

       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN 'no run' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL AND (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms < 60000 THEN 'starting'
            WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL OR (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms > 60000 THEN 'lost'
            WHEN (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms > 10000 THEN 'stale · ' || CASE WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END
            ELSE 'up ' || CASE WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END END AS "Run",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') ELSE to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') END AS "Start / End",

            ELSE CASE CASE WHEN s.phase IN ('regular', 'close_window') THEN 'Regular' WHEN s.session_end_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.ts_ms >= q.sc AND s.ts_ms < q.sc + 14400000 THEN 'After-Hours'

              WHEN q.t >= q.d + time '04:00' AND q.t < q.d + time '09:30' THEN 'Pre-Market' ELSE 'Closed' END

                        (extract(epoch FROM (s.session_id::date + time '16:00') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') * 1000)::bigint) AS sc,
               (to_timestamp(s.session_end_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS d,
               to_timestamp(s.ts_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS t) q) END WHEN 'Pre-Market' THEN 'Pre‑Mkt' WHEN 'Regular' THEN 'Regular' WHEN 'After-Hours' THEN 'After‑Hrs' WHEN 'Overnight' THEN 'Overnight' WHEN 'Closed' THEN 'Closed' ELSE 'no data' END END AS "Phase",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE coalesce(nullif(concat_ws(' · ',

            CASE WHEN s.conflict_bear THEN '$bear conflict' WHEN NOT s.depth_ok_bear THEN '$bear unusable' END), ''), 'ok') END AS "Books",
       (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'none open' WHEN NOT (SELECT sel.stopped_ms IS NULL FROM sel) THEN count(*) || ' left open'
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.unknown) > 0 THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.unknown) || ' unknown'

        FROM trade.cex_order o WHERE o.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND o.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (o.unknown OR o.status IN ('pending', 'acked'))) AS "Orders",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE CASE WHEN s.idle_reason IS NULL THEN 'order sent' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_signal' THEN 'ready' WHEN 'await_depth' THEN 'awaiting book' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'await_close' THEN 'awaiting flat' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'action_window' THEN 'dividend window' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'capital_pending' THEN 'capital pending' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_levels' THEN 'held · book thin' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'depth_bull' THEN 'held · $bull depth' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'depth_bear' THEN 'held · $bear depth' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'conflict_bull' THEN 'held · $bull conflict' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'conflict_bear' THEN 'held · $bear conflict' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'fx_stale' THEN 'held · F stale' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'rejected_backoff' THEN 'held · backing off' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_anchor' THEN 'held · no anchor' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'depth' THEN 'held · exit depth' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_price' THEN 'held panels.title: Account
panels.description:
The venue's side of the Run at its newest inventory sample (every 10 s). The program takes no decision from these (PRD 6.6); the board's own lines colour them.

- **Position**: the open round trip's side and how long it has been open; flat (the venue holds nothing on either leg); residual (amber): what the venue still holds per leg with no round trip open (dust); left open (red): a stopped Run's.
- **Ledger**: match (the venue's positions equal the program's ledger), mismatch (no orders until a person checks) or not read.
- **Equity**: Bitget usdtEquity of the WHOLE account, USDT (it also holds the sibling repository's positions); paper: none.
- **Maint. Margin**: the account's maintenance margin, USDT: margin ratio × equity.
- **Margin Ratio**: Bitget mgnRatio of the whole account (maintenance margin ÷ equity): ok below 30 %, warn below 60 %, high from there.
- **Liquidation**: the nearer leg's liquidation price from its mark, in % of the mark: ok beyond 25 %, warn beyond 10 %, near within; flat without a position; prices in Inventory.
- **Funding**: booked to the Run's round trips, USDT (+ received), or the settlements still without a record (n awaited).

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel),
     r AS (SELECT * FROM sel), sr AS (SELECT * FROM sel),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND s.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND s.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample i WHERE i.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND i.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND i.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND i.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY i.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1), h AS (SELECT sum(l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) AS q_bull,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull END) AS v_bull,
             sum(l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) AS q_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear END) AS v_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear ELSE 0 END) AS fee,
             max(c.direction) AS dir, min(c.opened_ms) AS opened_ms
      FROM trade.cycle c JOIN trade.lot l ON l.live = c.live AND l.cycle_id = c.cycle_id
      WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.status = 'open' AND l.status IN ('building', 'open')), lq AS (SELECT x.leg, x.d FROM i CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('$bull', CASE WHEN i.pos_bull < 0 THEN (i.liq_bull - i.mark_bull) / nullif(i.mark_bull, 0) WHEN i.pos_bull > 0 THEN (i.mark_bull - i.liq_bull) / nullif(i.mark_bull, 0) END),
  ('$bear', CASE WHEN i.pos_bear < 0 THEN (i.liq_bear - i.mark_bear) / nullif(i.mark_bear, 0) WHEN i.pos_bear > 0 THEN (i.mark_bear - i.liq_bear) / nullif(i.mark_bear, 0) END)) x(leg, d)
  WHERE x.d IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.d LIMIT 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL AND r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN h.dir || ' left open'
            WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL THEN h.dir || ' · ' || CASE WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm' WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END
            WHEN i.ts_ms IS NULL OR i.pos_bull IS NULL OR i.pos_bear IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            WHEN i.pos_bull = 0 AND i.pos_bear = 0 THEN 'flat'
            ELSE 'residual · ' || concat_ws(' ', CASE WHEN i.pos_bull <> 0 THEN '$bull ' || CASE WHEN i.pos_bull > 0 THEN '+' WHEN i.pos_bull < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '' END || trim_scale(abs(i.pos_bull))::text END, CASE WHEN i.pos_bear <> 0 THEN '$bear ' || CASE WHEN i.pos_bear > 0 THEN '+' WHEN i.pos_bear < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '' END || trim_scale(abs(i.pos_bear))::text END) END AS "Position",
       CASE WHEN i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN i.mismatch THEN 'mismatch' WHEN i.pos_bull IS NULL OR i.pos_bear IS NULL THEN 'not read'
            ELSE 'match' END AS "Ledger",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.equity IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE to_char(i.equity, 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END AS "Equity",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.equity IS NULL OR i.margin_ratio IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE to_char(i.margin_ratio * i.equity, 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END AS "Maint. Margin",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.margin_ratio IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE CASE WHEN i.margin_ratio < 0.3 THEN 'ok' WHEN i.margin_ratio < 0.6 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'high' END
                 || ' · ' || to_char(100 * i.margin_ratio, 'FM990.00') || ' %' END AS "Margin Ratio",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN coalesce(i.pos_bull, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(i.pos_bear, 0) = 0 THEN 'flat' WHEN lq.d IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE CASE WHEN lq.d < 0.1 THEN 'near' WHEN lq.d < 0.25 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END
                 || ' · ' || lq.leg || ' ' || to_char(100 * lq.d, 'FM999,990') || ' %' END AS "Liquidation",
       (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) > 0) > 0
                    THEN sum(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) ELSE 0 END) || ' awaited'
                    ELSE CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(c.funding) FILTER (WHERE c.funding_known), 0) < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '+' END || to_char(abs(coalesce(sum(c.funding) FILTER (WHERE c.funding_known), 0)), 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END
        FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL))) AS "Funding"
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN r ON true LEFT JOIN s ON true LEFT JOIN i ON true LEFT JOIN h ON true LEFT JOIN lq ON true

panels.title: Market · Prices
panels.description:
The Run's newest second (its age: the Run tile above), as Combo Spread's Prices · Latest Second; whatever the Range.

- **${bull} Price**: Each leg's mid on the program's book, USDT.
- **${bull} Anchor**: Each leg's anchor, USD per share: the bell (F × Binance's index at the close), then the issuer's NAV once confirmed.
- **Anchor**: As Combo Spread's Anchor Status: NAV, Bell (provisional, grey) or Missing (amber: no entries).
- **F · USD/USDT**: USD per USDT (Coinbase USDT-USD), the rate the program converts with: a price in USDT × F is in USD; an anchor in USD ÷ F is in USDT (owner item 80; Combo Spread's USD/USDT).

panels.title: Market · Real Spread and Signal
panels.description:
The same second, as Combo Spread's Spread and Signal · Latest Second; every spread figure in bps.

- **Real Spread**: Owner item 80: the spread at both legs' pricing levels, buying both (Long: where a Long enters and a Short exits) and selling both (Short), in spread bps: 10⁴ × (F × (P_bull ÷ A_bull + P_bear ÷ A_bear) − 2), the two legs' deviations added, as Combo Spread writes it (1 bps of spread is 0.5 bps of the two legs' notional).
- **Mean**: The program's mean of the spread (on the mids), bps.
- **波动率 (σ)**: 波动率 (σ): the standard deviation of the spread, bps.
- **Deviation**: Spread on the mids − Mean, in bps and in σ.
- **Signal**: In Combo Spread's words, on the program's executable deviations: Long (Buy Both at or past −d_in σ), Short (Sell Both at or past +d_in σ), None inside; No Anchor, No Mean (σ not ready), No Book (a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable: the program enters on none).

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description:
What stopped or held trading in the picked Run and what became of it: the unfinished first, each group newest first, at most 200.

- **Severity**: critical: position mismatch, a lost or stale Run, an entry held for a person (settings, records, mismatch), a program error; serious: a sample gap, one leg only, a forced exit, an order rejected, unknown, never arrived or not found; warning: an entry held back (a book, F, no anchor, backing off, a stop pending), a stop or session end while holding, dust, funding awaited, an order not sent.
- **Status**: Open: a person is needed; In Progress: the program is still on it (only while the Run runs, else Open); Recovered: it ended by itself; Recorded: dust, recorded and not processed (owner item 47).
- **Time**: when it happened, UTC+8; for an entry held back, the start of its newest episode.
- **Source**: the part it belongs to: the Run, the positions, the entry, an order or a round trip (click a round trip's Source for its orders below).
- **What, Detail**: what happened, and its figures: for an entry held back, how often, how long in all and at most, and the seconds an executable deviation was past an entry line meanwhile (the entries it cost).

panels.title: Summary
panels.description:
The Run's round trips closed in the Range (row title), in the owner's order (item 76); money in USDT (U), Notional and Peak Used in USDT.

- **PnL**: Gross + Fee + Funding of the round trips closed in the Range, USDT: what the strategy earned (one whose funding is not known yet left out until it is).
- **Gross**: Both legs' fills, sells less buys, before costs.
- **Fee**: Trading fees, as a cost (negative).
- **Funding**: Funding booked to them; + received.
- **Open PnL**: The open round trip at the newest second's mids after its entry fees, before exit fees and the half spread an exit pays; green above zero, red below; not in PnL.
- **Notional**: Traded: both legs' fills (entries, completions, trims, exits) of those round trips, USDT.
- **Peak Used**: The most of N = M × L in use in the Range (held at entry prices, open orders, dust), USDT, from the Run's inventory samples.
- **Win Rate**: Closed round trips with a positive PnL.
- **Return**: PnL over Peak Used, bps (owner item 69: a return on the largest notional actually used).

- **Held**: Time since the round trip opened.

panels.title: Spread · bps
panels.description:
After Combo Spread's Spread chart (owner item 81), in spread bps: 10⁴ × (F × (P_bull ÷ A_bull + P_bear ÷ A_bear) − 2), the two legs' deviations added (1 bps of spread is 0.5 bps of the two legs' notional), on the time picker's axis.

- **Real Long Spread**: buying both legs at their pricing levels (blue): a Long enters when it falls to Mean − d_in σ (blue dashed), a Short exits when it falls to Mean + d_out σ (orange dotted).
- **Real Short Spread**: selling both (orange): a Short enters when it rises to Mean + d_in σ (orange dashed), a Long exits when it rises to Mean − d_out σ (blue dotted).
- **Mean**: the program's mean of the spread on the mids.
- **Markers**: Markers (owner item 81): a long entry a green triangle ▲, a short entry a red triangle ▼, an exit a circle ● (a forced exit amber, a trim, completion or void entry a small grey one), at the decision's executable spread; hover one for its Execution ID (the round trip's opening, UTC+8, owner item 83: every marker of one round trip — entries, completions, trims, exits — has the same, as its row in Round Trips), the action, each leg's filled contracts and average price, the notional, the fees and the round trip's PnL.
- **Points and marks**: Points: every second up to 25 min, then 5, 10, 30 s and whole minutes (a real spread is its bucket's extreme on its entry side, of the seconds whose books the program enters on: none, and tooltip Book Not OK, where a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable, owner item 70); a gap: no sample (process down), or a new session or run; shaded: each round trip from entry to exit (blue Long, orange Short; its mark under the chart: times, end reason, PnL); purple marks: a change of the anchors in use, with reason and both legs' anchors before → after (owner item 62).

panels.description:
After Combo Spread's Deviation chart (owner item 81): the Spread chart with its Mean at zero, in spread bps.

- **Deviation**: spread on the mids − Mean (purple).
- **Real Long Deviation, Real Short Deviation**: the real spreads − Mean (blue, orange): a Long enters when blue falls to −d_in σ (blue dashed) and exits when orange rises to −d_out σ (blue dotted); a Short the mirror (orange lines).

panels.description:
Every order of the picked round trip (the Range's newest by default), in the order the program sent them, its fills folded in.

- **Purpose**: Entry, Complete (the leg that filled less), Trim (the leg that filled more), Exit, Forced.
- **Side**: Buy or Sell; RO: a reduce-only order.
- **Qty, Filled**: contracts ordered and filled.
- **Limit, Avg**: the limit and the fills' average price, USDT, to the leg's tick.
- **Fee**: USDT, as a contribution (a cost negative); Pending while the venue has not reported it.
- **Latency**: sent → final state in hand, ms, this host's clock (paper: the configured simulation).

panels.title: Positions Now · ct, USDT and Bps
panels.description:
Each leg at the Run's newest inventory sample (every 10 s), whatever the Range; the venue's figures live only (the paper venue reports positions alone).

- **Venue, Ledger**: the venue's position and the program's ledger (dust included), contracts, signed (+ long, − short); they must match.
- **Mark, Liq Price**: the venue's mark and liquidation price, USDT.
- **Liq Distance**: the liquidation price from the mark, in % of the mark: amber within 25 %, red within 10 %.
- **Venue UPL**: the venue's unrealised P&L of the leg, USDT.
- **Exposure**: the position at the newest second's mid, USDT, signed.
- **Funding**: the newest settled funding rate × 10⁴ (bps of the position's value per settlement), as Bitget publishes it: + longs pay shorts.
- **Age**: seconds since the sample while the Run runs; amber past a minute.

panels.title: Runs · Both Modes
panels.description:
Every start of the program, both modes, newest first, as the Run picker lists them (the one shown marked), whatever the filters.

- **Run**: click to show that Run, its whole life on the charts.
- **State**: Running (a sample in the last minute), Stopped (in order), Lost (neither: crashed or killed).
- **Ran**: start to stop, or to now.
- **N**: the notional M × L it may hold, USDT.
- **Run ID**: process_run.run_id.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)
SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') || '–' || CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NULL THEN 'now' WHEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD') = to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD') THEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') ELSE to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') END || ' · Bitget · ' || replace(coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS'), ' / ', '/') || ' · ' || CASE WHEN r.live THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Paper' END || CASE WHEN r.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) THEN ' · shown' ELSE '' END AS "Run", to_timestamp(r.started_ms / 1000.0) AS "Started",
       to_timestamp(r.stopped_ms / 1000.0) AS "Stopped", initcap(CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 60000 AND s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.live = r.live) THEN 'running' WHEN (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms < 60000 THEN 'starting' ELSE 'lost' END) AS "State", CASE WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN (coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END AS "Ran",
       (r.config #>> '{inventory,capital}')::numeric * (r.config #>> '{inventory,leverage}')::numeric AS "N",
       r.host AS "Host", r.run_id AS "Run ID", r.started_ms::text AS from_ms, coalesce(r.stopped_ms::text, 'now') AS to_ms
FROM trade.process_run r
ORDER BY r.started_ms DESC LIMIT 100

- **Value**: USD per share.
- **Known**: when the program learned it, UTC+8.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

panels.title: Funding Records · USDT

list.label: Round Trip
list.description: The round trip whose orders are shown: the Range's newest (the default); a click on Opened in Round Trips, on a point of Net per Round Trip or on an alert's Source picks one.

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || initcap(c.direction) || ' · ' || coalesce(CASE c.end_reason WHEN 'exit_line' THEN 'Exit Line' WHEN 'close_window' THEN 'Flattened Before Close' WHEN 'stop' THEN 'Program Stopped' WHEN 'session_changed' THEN 'Session Ended' WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 'No Fill' WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 'One Leg Only' WHEN 'dust_only' THEN 'Trimmed to Dust' WHEN 'store_error' THEN 'Not Recorded' ELSE initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')) END, 'Open') AS __text, c.cycle_id AS __value
  FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.opened_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) AND coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill' ORDER BY c.opened_ms DESC LIMIT 500) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'No Round Trip in the Range', 'none'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.opened_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) AND coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill')

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sel) THEN 'no Run' WHEN rg.from_ms >= rg.to_ms THEN 'empty: Until not after Since'

SELECT c.opened_ms AS time, coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS time_end,
       initcap(c.direction) || ' ' || to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS') || ' – ' || coalesce(to_char(to_timestamp((c.closed_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI:SS'), 'open') || ' · ' || coalesce(CASE c.end_reason WHEN 'exit_line' THEN 'Exit Line' WHEN 'close_window' THEN 'Flattened Before Close' WHEN 'stop' THEN 'Program Stopped' WHEN 'session_changed' THEN 'Session Ended' WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 'No Fill' WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 'One Leg Only' WHEN 'dust_only' THEN 'Trimmed to Dust' WHEN 'store_error' THEN 'Not Recorded' ELSE initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')) END, 'Open') || ' · Net '
       || CASE WHEN c.status = 'open' THEN 'open' WHEN NOT c.funding_known THEN 'Pending' ELSE to_char(c.net, 'FM999,990.00') || ' USDT' END AS text
FROM trade.cycle c
WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.direction = 'long' AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill' AND c.opened_ms <= least($__to, (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) - 1)

both legs'' NAV unchanged for 1 h (Direxion' || coalesce(': first seen ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((min(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav_seen' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ', confirmed ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((max(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms), '') || ')' WHEN x.pk = 'nav' AND x.anchor_kind = 'bell' THEN 'the bell again: the NAV no longer confirmed' WHEN (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) IS NOT NULL THEN 'a dividend takes effect (anchor less the dividend; read for the session: ' || (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ' USD)' ELSE 'a split, or a corrected reading, of the same kind' END || '
' || '$bull ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
' || '$bear ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
USDT = USD ÷ F, F = ' || CASE WHEN x.pf = x.f THEN x.f::text ELSE coalesce(x.pf::text, '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(x.f::text, '–') END || ' USD/USDT (the program''s)' AS text FROM (SELECT s.ts_ms, s.session_id, s.anchor_kind, s.anchor_bull, s.anchor_bear, s.f, lag(s.ts_ms) OVER w AS pts, lag(s.session_id) OVER w AS ps, lag(s.anchor_kind) OVER w AS pk, lag(s.anchor_bull) OVER w AS p_bull, lag(s.anchor_bear) OVER w AS p_bear, lag(s.f) OVER w AS pf FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.ts_ms >= greatest($__from, (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg)) - 600000 AND s.ts_ms <= least($__to, (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) - 1) AND s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY s.ts_ms)) x WHERE x.ts_ms >= greatest($__from, (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg)) AND x.pts IS NOT NULL AND (x.anchor_kind, x.anchor_bull, x.anchor_bear) IS DISTINCT FROM (x.pk, x.p_bull, x.p_bear)
